# Vendored QuickAdd helper subset

Source: https://github.com/chhoumann/quickadd
Version: 2.30.0
Commit: 943649ddb105ee166c52b44222e7178d7632a98a
License: MIT (LICENSE)

Three unchanged source modules and their unchanged tests are copied with original
paths: capturePlacement, userText and noteContentInsertion. This is not the full
QuickAdd engine. Adapters and the content-only Obsidian host boundary live outside
this directory. Generated bundles and notices are in plugins.
